add.k: A monk in rural Japan, Wolverine's old spiritual teacher
st: In season 4, Master Oku welcomes Logan back to build a temple, counsels him on his true nature and faces down the Silver Samurai's men.

files.notes: Only in The Lotus and the Steel (MD S4E13; ep 60 in the app's order). Named 'Master Oku' and 'Oku' in dialogue and speaks. Trapped when the Samurai's men set the temple alight. No group named on screen (a lone monk building a temple), so Independent.

add.k: The scientist leading the Starcore shuttle mission
st: In season 3, Dr. Corbeau flies the Starcore to Eagle One, where Erik the Red seizes him, then Jean flies the shuttle home.

files.notes: On screen in The Phoenix Saga parts I and II (eps 29 and 30); only mentioned in part III. Said on screen as 'Dr. Corbeau' only; 'Peter' is never said, so n is Dr. Corbeau. NASA is mentioned ('He informed me that NASA cannot explain...') but he is never said to work for it, so Independent.

add.k: A member of the Thieves Guild in New Orleans
st: In season 2, Pierre phones Gambit when Bobby vanishes, then takes him to the Assassins, who trade Bobby and the tithe for Gambit.
In season 1, Pierre stands with Bobby among the mourners at Gambit's funeral.

files.notes: TAS: X-Ternally Yours (ep 19); named in dialogue ('Remy, it Pierre') and speaks. X-Men '97 S1E7 (Bright Eyes): stands beside Bobby at Gambit's funeral (Slashfilm; Wikipedia season 1 article). X-Men '97 S2E8 (The Dead Man's Hand): the Marvel Database's main image is captioned as from that episode and the Thieves Guild members there fall under Gambit's thrall, but no non-wiki source puts Pierre on screen, so no step; add one if the episode shows him. 'The Thieves Guild' is the app's existing group name.

add.k: A speedster mutant on Forge's X-Factor team
st: In season 3, Quicksilver is on Forge's X-Factor team in its brawl with the X-Men when Iceman comes looking for Lorna.
In season 4, Quicksilver and his twin Wanda trap Magneto over their mother, then learn from the High Evolutionary he is their father.
In season 5, the Phalanx takes Quicksilver after he meets Beast and Forge, until Magneto helps free him.

files.notes: Cold Comfort (ep 37, Forge names him), Family Ties (ep 58, 'Pietro and Wanda Maximoff'), Phalanx Covenant I and II (eps 67 and 68). Skipped cameos with no action: a vision in Repo Man, Sanctuary II, an illusion in Xavier Remembers. X-Men '97 lists him on Forge's roster as off world but he is not seen, so no step. Scarlet Witch has no app file in this title, so no tie for her.

n: A Morlock with a fever touch
k: A Morlock whose touch spreads fever
A Morlock remade as a Horseman of Apocalypse
A Morlock who once served Apocalypse
st: In season 1, a Morlock gives Gambit a fever in a fight with the X-Men, then seeks a cure and becomes Apocalypse's Horseman Pestilence.
In season 4, Pestilence, back in her old form, is among the Morlocks when Storm hands their leadership back to Callisto.

files.notes: Captive Hearts (ep 5), Come the Apocalypse (ep 10), Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas (ep 62, appearance only). 'Plague' is never said as a name (her own pun 'Got a touch of the plague?' in ep 5 does not name her); 'Pestilence' is said by Apocalypse and by her ('the touch of Pestilence') in ep 10, so the file goes by Pestilence, staged from ep 10. That she is one of the Muir Island cure seekers rests on the Marvel Database and the ep 10 plot. Season 4 is a background appearance (Marvel Database lists her); the sentence keeps to the scene's main event.

add.k: The elder of an Inuit fishing camp in the Arctic
st: In season 1, the elder Pooyetah takes in a half-frozen Wolverine, then Sabretooth wrecks his camp and holds him hostage on a glacier.

files.notes: Only in Cold Vengeance (ep 6). Names himself ('I am Pooyetah, elder of this camp'). Wolverine frees the hostages; Pooyetah then decides his people will move to the city. The fishing camp has no group name, so Independent.

add.k: A one-eyed warrior in Mojo's crew, Longshot's rival
st: In season 3, Quark comes to Earth in Mojo's crew and takes on Wolverine, then goes after Longshot, who knocks him out.

files.notes: Only in Longshot (MD S5E5; ep 36, season 3 in the app's order). Named in dialogue ('Quark, who do you want to be? The guy who bumped off an Earther, or the man who defeated Longshot?') and answers. The transcript has no speaker label for that line; the batch note says Mojo says it. 'Mojo's network' is the app's existing group for Mojo's people.

add.k: A corrupt commander of the Shi'ar patrol
st: In season 3, Commander Raknar chases Corsair to Earth to silence the witness Jandra, until the X-Men expose him and hand him over.

files.notes: Only in Orphan's End (ep 44). Names himself: 'This is Commander Raknar of the Shi'ar Intergalactic Patrol, under the authority of Empress Lilandra.' Grouped under the app's 'Shi'ar Empire' (the Patrol is the Empire's police arm); 'The Shi'ar Intergalactic Patrol' is the screen name if a separate group is preferred. The X-Men turn him over to Shi'ar justice at the end.

st: In season 3, Raza fires on the X-Men to take the M'Kraan Crystal for Corsair, and later guards a captive Storm while hiding Jandra.

files.notes: On screen in The Phoenix Saga parts IV and V (eps 32 and 33) and Orphan's End (ep 44), all season 3, so one step. Named by Corsair ('Fire, Raza!', 'No, Raza'); 'Longknife' is never said, so n is Raza. Not the Iron Man Raza.

add.k: Nathaniel Essex's ailing wife in Victorian London
st: In season 5, in Victorian London, Rebecca takes her husband Nathaniel Essex's secret treatments, then flees from what he has become.

files.notes: Only in Descent (MD S5E13; ep 75). Named in dialogue ('How is Rebecca faring?', 'Rebecca, darling'); 'Grey' is never said as her name (she is Lord Grey's daughter), so n is Rebecca. Xavier's narration says she never spoke another word. James Xavier and Lord Grey have no network name in the app, so no ties to them.

add.k: A monk who turns a town against Nightcrawler
st: In season 4, Brother Reinhard rouses Neuherzl's mob against his fellow monk Nightcrawler and storms the burning abbey, then repents.

files.notes: Only in Nightcrawler (MD S3E18; ep 53, season 4 in the app's order). The transcript spells it 'Brother Reinhard'; the Marvel Database has 'Reinhart'. Raft file: he works against the heroes until his last scene, where he repents and is forgiven. 'Nightcrawler's monastery' is the app's existing group name for the abbey.

add.k: Mojo's six-armed assistant who opens portals
st: In season 2, Spiral runs Mojo's shows starring the captive X-Men, until Longshot makes her send them home.
In season 3, Spiral leads Mojo's warriors after Longshot on Earth and opens the way for Mojo's televised hunt, then flees home.
In season 1, Spiral helps run Mojo's deadly video game that traps Jubilee and Roberto, but fails to stop a bug helping them.

files.notes: Mojovision (ep 24), Longshot (ep 36), X-Men '97 S1E4 (ep 4). Named in dialogue in all three ('Spiral! Would you show our cast to the studio', 'Patch that bug, Spiral!'). Longshot says of her 'We used to date' in Longshot. 'Mojo's network' is the app's existing group for Mojo's people.

k: A senator running for president against mutants
The U.S. president, now a friend to mutants
st: In season 1, anti-mutant Senator Kelly runs for president, but after the X-Men save him from Magneto and Master Mold, he defends them.
In season 2, Kelly is sworn in as president and pardons Beast, and his old anti-mutant backers turn on him.
In season 4, President Kelly weighs a strike on Magneto's armed Asteroid M as Xavier warns it could start a nuclear war.
In season 5, the Phalanx takes over President Kelly and uses his emergency line to lure Beast into an ambush.
In season 1, after Genosha, President Kelly turns down Cyclops's plea for more help, then lets Xavier's X-Men try to stop Magneto.

files.notes: TAS: on TV in eps 1 and 2, press conference ep 4, Days of Future Past II and The Final Decision (eps 12 and 13); sworn in, Till Death Do Us Part I (ep 14); Sanctuary I and II (eps 48 and 49); Phalanx Covenant I (ep 67, 'your President is no longer human'). Mentions only in Time Fugitives I, Beauty and the Beast, Courage, Jubilee's Fairytale Theatre, Hidden Agendas. X-Men '97 S1: eps 7 and 9 on screen (ep 10 at the UN vote, 'Mr. President, the gravity core', not described). X-Men '97 S2 only mentions him (his order outlawing X-Men activity in ep 16, conceding the election to Graydon Creed on the news in ep 19); no on-screen appearance confirmed, so no step. Groups: 'U.S. Congress' (the app's group for a senator, Senator Stern) and 'The White House' from his swearing in (ep 14), as for Thaddeus Ross and the Vice President.

add.k: Gambit's brother, a leader of the Thieves Guild
st: In season 2, the Assassins kidnap Gambit's brother Bobby, and Gambit trades himself for Bobby and the Thieves' tithe.
In season 1, Bobby is among the mourners at his brother Gambit's funeral.
In season 2, Bobby faces his brother Gambit back from the dead, who bends his mind against the X-Men until Rogue frees him.

files.notes: TAS: X-Ternally Yours (ep 19), named 'Bobby' by Pierre and Gambit, speaks. X-Men '97 S1E7 (Bright Eyes): the long-haired blond man beside Pierre at Gambit's funeral (Slashfilm; Wikipedia season 1 article); not named there. X-Men '97 S2E8 (The Dead Man's Hand, ep 18, aired August 2026): greeted as 'Robert', asks 'What happened, big brother?', and is later seen under Gambit's control ('Bella Donna? Robert? What's he done to ya?'); Wikipedia says Rogue's victory frees Gambit's followers. Wikipedia's season 2 cast lists Bobby LeBeau.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Logan returns to rural Japan and helps his old teacher Master Oku build a temple. Oku tells him peace comes with purpose and urges him to see himself through new eyes, and Logan ends up defending the village from the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: The former student who helps him build a temple
stages.whoB: His old spiritual teacher in Japan

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Silver Samurai's men demand tribute from the village, and Master Oku is trapped when smoke pours from his temple. When they come back, Oku steps out and dares the warriors to attack him instead.
stages.whoA: Bandit leader whose men threaten his village
stages.whoB: Monk who stands up to his men

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Erik the Red, posing as the Eagle One crew's host, gasses the Starcore's crew and has Dr. Corbeau brought to his control room. Corbeau begs the stowaway X-Men to stop him from destroying the alien ship.
stages.whoA: Shi'ar agent who takes him prisoner on Eagle One
stages.whoB: Shuttle scientist he takes prisoner

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast knows of Dr. Corbeau's solar vortex study, and Corbeau is stunned to find Hank McCoy aboard his shuttle. Beast and Jean then set out to rescue him from Erik the Red.
stages.whoA: X-Man who stows away to save him
stages.whoB: Starcore scientist he helps rescue

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jean senses the trap on Eagle One and warns Dr. Corbeau back to the shuttle. When the autopilot fails, she absorbs his flight training to fly it home and rises from the crash as Phoenix.
stages.whoA: X-Man who warns him of the trap on Eagle One
stages.whoB: Scientist whose shuttle she flies home

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pierre calls Remy at Xavier's school because Bobby is missing on the night of the tithe. He meets Gambit in the swamp and goes with him to the Assassins to make the trade.
stages.whoA: Old guild friend he calls home for help
stages.whoB: Thieves Guild friend who calls him home

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Pierre stands with Bobby among the mourners at Gambit's funeral. Nightcrawler gives the eulogy as the X-Men lay Gambit to rest.
stages.whoA: Old guild friend whose funeral he attends
stages.whoB: Thieves Guild friend at his funeral

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pierre raises the alarm when Bobby is taken by the Assassins on the night of the tithe. Gambit and Pierre win Bobby back, and the Thieves return to their base together.
stages.whoA: Guild leader he helps rescue
stages.whoB: Fellow Thief who helps get him back

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Believing Magneto killed their mother, Quicksilver and Wanda lure him into a trap, and the High Evolutionary reveals that Magneto is their father. Later the Phalanx takes Pietro, and Magneto joins the fight to save him, greeting him with relief once he is free.
stages.whoA: His father, whom he first blames for his mother's death
stages.whoB: His son, one of the Maximoff twins

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Forge introduces Quicksilver as part of his government team X-Factor when they meet the X-Men. Quicksilver is with Forge's group when the Phalanx strikes and takes him.
stages.whoA: Leader of his X-Factor team
stages.whoB: Speedster on his X-Factor team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast meets Quicksilver and Forge to warn them of the Phalanx, and Pietro doubts the story until the aliens ambush them. Beast then works to free him and the others from the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: X-Man who warns him of the Phalanx
stages.whoB: X-Factor speedster he helps save

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Apocalypse turns the mutants who come to Muir Island for a cure into his Horsemen and names Pestilence among his agents of destruction. When the X-Men beat the Horsemen, he calls them unworthy.
stages.whoA: Master who remakes her as his Horseman
stages.whoB: One of his Horsemen

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Under Callisto's orders, the fever-touch Morlock helps kidnap Cyclops and Jean and fights the X-Men. Back among the Morlocks at Christmas, she is there when Callisto takes back the leadership.
stages.whoA: Leader of the Morlocks
stages.whoB: One of her Morlocks

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the Morlock tunnels the fever-touch Morlock fights the X-Men until Storm beats Callisto in a duel. As Pestilence she comes at the X-Men in Paris, and Storm's fog throws her from her horse.
stages.whoA: X-Man whose fog throws her from her horse
stages.whoB: Morlock and Horseman she fights twice

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the Morlock fight she lays hands on Gambit and gives him a fever, mocking him that he has a touch of the plague. Storm sends Rogue to get him back to the mansion.
stages.whoA: X-Man she strikes down with a fever
stages.whoB: Morlock who gives him a fever

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pestilence and War are among the mutants Apocalypse remakes as his Horsemen. They attack the peace conference in Paris together and fall to the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Fellow Horseman of Apocalypse
stages.whoB: Fellow Horseman of Apocalypse

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pooyetah takes the half-frozen Wolverine into his tent and later sees him become the camp's hero. When Sabretooth takes the villagers hostage, Wolverine saves them, and Pooyetah calls him friend.
stages.whoA: Stranger he nurses back to health
stages.whoB: Inuit elder who saves him from the ice

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sabretooth tracks Wolverine to the fishing camp, destroys it and ties Pooyetah and the others to an ice bridge rigged to blow. Wolverine beats him and frees them.
stages.whoA: Mutant who wrecks his camp and takes him hostage
stages.whoB: Elder he takes hostage on the glacier

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Quark corners Wolverine until he is asked whether he would rather be the man who defeated Longshot. He goes after Longshot instead and is quickly knocked out.
stages.whoA: Star he wants to be known for beating
stages.whoB: Rival in Mojo's crew he knocks out

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Quark is one of the crew Mojo brings to Earth for his televised hunt of the X-Men. When the broadcast is wrecked, the crew heads home with Mojo.
stages.whoA: Master he serves on the hunt
stages.whoB: One of his crew

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Quark gets the drop on Wolverine during Mojo's hunt, but turns away to chase Longshot. Wolverine shrugs it off, saying he heals fast.
stages.whoA: X-Man he attacks during Mojo's hunt
stages.whoB: One of Mojo's warriors

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar hunts Corsair across the galaxy and brands him a kidnapper, while Corsair says Raknar is a bad cop. Raknar captures Corsair and admits he was hired to kill the witness, before the Starjammers turn the tables.
stages.whoA: Pirate he hunts to Earth
stages.whoB: Shi'ar officer hunting him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar convinces Cyclops that Corsair is after a fortune, and Cyclops turns his father in. Once the truth comes out, Cyclops helps take Raknar down.
stages.whoA: X-Man he tricks into turning on Corsair
stages.whoB: Shi'ar commander who tricks him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raza and the Starjammers hide the witness Jandra from Raknar's patrol. They rejoin Corsair to defeat Raknar's ship.
stages.whoA: Starjammer protecting the witness he hunts
stages.whoB: Shi'ar commander hunting their crew

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raza takes Corsair's orders aboard the Starjammer and fires the stun ray on the X-Men when told. Later he helps keep the witness Jandra safe while Raknar holds Corsair.
stages.whoA: His captain
stages.whoB: One of his Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Nathaniel Essex tries to cure his wife Rebecca and secretly treats her with his experiments. When the mob drives him home, she sees the monster he has made of himself and runs from him.
stages.whoA: Her husband, whose cure turns him into a monster
stages.whoB: His sick wife, whom he tries to cure

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Brother Reinhard thinks his fellow monk Nightcrawler is a demon and leads the townspeople up to burn him out. Nightcrawler spares him in the flames, and Reinhard repents.
stages.whoA: Fellow monk he takes for a demon
stages.whoB: Brother monk who turns the town on him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Spiral works Mojo's studio, showing his captive X-Men to the set and pushing the applause button. She later opens the way for his trip to Earth and he calls on her to get him out when the hunt goes wrong.
stages.whoA: Master she produces shows for
stages.whoB: His assistant and producer

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Spiral helps run Mojo's deadly video game for Jubilee and Roberto. Mojo snaps at her to patch the bug that keeps helping them.
stages.whoA: Master whose game she runs
stages.whoB: Assistant he scolds over a bug

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Longshot quits Mojo, he makes Spiral send the captive X-Men home. On Earth she leads the hunt for him, and he admits they used to date.
stages.whoA: Rebel star she hunts, and an old flame
stages.whoB: Mojo's aide and his old flame

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Spiral's warriors chase Longshot when Jubilee runs into him on a driving lesson. Jubilee later ends up in Mojo's hands before the X-Men rescue her.
stages.whoA: Young X-Man caught up in Mojo's hunt
stages.whoB: Mojo's aide hunting Longshot

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Spiral helps keep Jubilee trapped in Mojo's deadly video game. A bug keeps giving Jubilee and Roberto extra lives, and Spiral cannot stop it.
stages.whoA: Player trapped in Mojo's game
stages.whoB: Mojo's aide running the game

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier's X-Men save Senator Kelly from Magneto and Master Mold, and Kelly comes to defend good mutants. As president he weighs a strike on Asteroid M while Xavier warns him against it.
stages.whoA: Mutant leader whose X-Men save his life
stages.whoB: Senator, then president, his X-Men protect

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Xavier asks President Kelly to let him reason with Magneto, and Kelly blames him for leaving his legacy to a lunatic. Xavier reminds him they have been here before and asks him to trust the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Mutant leader he trusts against Magneto
stages.whoB: President who lets his X-Men act

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Senator Kelly arranges Beast's bail, and his first act as president is a full pardon for him. Later the Phalanx uses Kelly's emergency line to lure Beast into a trap.
stages.whoA: X-Man he pardons as president
stages.whoB: Senator, then president, who frees him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Senator Kelly to a sunken ship to kill him and start a war, until Sentinels snatch Kelly away. As president, Kelly faces Magneto's armed Asteroid M.
stages.whoA: Mutant who kidnaps him to start a war
stages.whoB: Senator he kidnaps to kill

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops leads the mission to rescue Senator Kelly from Master Mold, and Jean and Cyclops get him out alive.
stages.whoA: X-Man who leads his rescue
stages.whoB: Senator he rescues from Master Mold

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: After Genosha, Cyclops asks President Kelly for more help finding survivors. Kelly refuses, citing scared voters, and tells him to be patient.
stages.whoA: X-Man whose plea for help he refuses
stages.whoB: President who refuses him help

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique, posing as Gambit, tries to assassinate Senator Kelly at his Senate hearing to frame the X-Men. The real Gambit stops her.
stages.whoA: Shapeshifter who tries to kill him
stages.whoB: Senator she tries to assassinate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Assassins seize Bobby to force his brother Remy home, and Remy blames Bobby for making him a Thief. Gambit trades himself to get Bobby and the tithe back.
stages.whoA: His brother Remy, the X-Man Gambit
stages.whoB: His brother, who made him a Thief

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Bobby mourns his brother at the funeral. Later Gambit returns from the dead, invites the guilds home and bends Bobby's mind, until Rogue frees them.
stages.whoA: His brother, back from the dead
stages.whoB: Brother whose mind he bends

dropped.why: Never named on screen: in Night of the Sentinels part II (her only on-screen episode) she is only 'the President' and 'Madam President' (springfieldspringfield x-men-1992 s01e02; the Marvel Database plot calls her 'an unnamed woman'). 'Margaret Jean-Louise Avery' is a writer's headcanon on X, not on screen. A title alone does not pass the name test (as with 'the shaman', 'Captain', 'Lieutenant' in earlier drops).
